material_findings.condition: A CloseHandle injected callback catches a postcommit store_scalar publication/cache error and then returns normally. The actual hook has already set c.stopped and retained the original accounting error.
material_findings.path: The normal wrapper-return path marks exit and calls _reconcile_native before checking c.stopped. For CloseHandle, _reconcile_native and _cache_committed_fact bypass the failed-work gate. The latter can therefore fill an UNOBSERVED cache on that same failed call from the committed bank; only afterward does _call raise the original error.
material_findings.conflict: This heals the interrupted same-call cache despite the F2 no-healing requirement. Bank knowledge and the original error remain retained, so this is a derived-cache boundary, not a loss of the committed raw row. A different fresh CloseHandle under an earlier work failure must remain legal.
